query:
Did everyone on Maple Street attend the summer street party?

Options:
A. Claudette
B. Femi
C. Jordan
D. Vera
context:
[1] (about=Femi, episodic, t5 @2025-05-26T17:30:00) Quick question for the street, summer street party! I know Len used to organise this but since he moved I've gone ahead and booked the road closure for the last Saturday of July. Same format as before: tables out front, bring something to share. Is everyone in? Need to know numbers for the council permit.
[2] (about=Femi, episodic, t6 @2025-05-26T18:02:00) Great, that's Claudette, Marcus's family, Jordan, and me confirmed. Vera, are you able to join this year?
[3] (about=Vera, episodic, t6 @2025-05-26T21:11:00) On call that weekend. Apologies.
[4] (about=Femi, episodic, t7 @2025-06-02T16:02:00) What a day. Best turnout we've had in years. Thanks all for making it work. Jordan, you were brilliant on the set-up. Claudette's sponge was the centrepiece as ever. Thanks all!
[5] (about=Claudette, episodic, t8 @2025-06-02T16:19:00) Femi, you have done Len proud. I was quite emotional seeing the whole street out together. This is what Maple Street is for, people, not parking schemes.
[6] (about=Jordan, episodic, t8 @2025-06-02T16:24:00) so lovely 🥹 Claudette tell me about Maple Street in the 90s sometime
[7] (about=Jordan, episodic, t8 @2025-06-02T16:40:00) seriously though Claudette, were the old parties this busy?
[8] (about=Femi, episodic, t2 @2025-05-12T18:15:00) Good to have views from everyone. So: Vera and Marcus in favour, Claudette against, Jordan neutral, me broadly yes with caveats. I'll represent that range at the consultation meeting. Thanks all.
[9] (about=Claudette, episodic, t8 @2025-06-02T16:42:00) busier sometimes. In the 90s people brought out cassette decks and stayed until dusk
[10] (about=Femi, episodic, t6 @2025-05-26T21:16:00) Understood, we'll save you a slice. Jordan already knows Claudette doesn't want new faces from outside the street, so let's keep it residents only this year.
agent_answer:
No — Vera did not attend. She was on call that weekend and apologized, later saying "save me a slice next time if I'm not on call." Claudette, Femi, and Jordan all attended (Femi organized it and confirmed himself, Claudette, Jordan, and Marcus's family; afterward he thanked everyone, praised Jordan's setup and Claudette's sponge).

**Answer: D. Vera**
